name: goDB Database Viewer
description: Full stack application that allows registered users to search for entries, and make modifications in a database. Simple and clean interface served by a Python backend and SQL database, capable of querying thousands of entries responsively.

0.alt: A screenshot of the search results for businesses matching the following pattern: name = Tim Horton, city = Edmonton, and sorted by number of stars. There are 41 results displayed in the main window on the page.

1.alt: A screenshot of the search results for users matching the following pattern: name = Mary, minimum review count = 10, average stars = 4.2. There are 10 results displayed in the main window on the page.

2.alt: A screenshot of the login page. There is an entry for the user to input a user ID, and a button to submit a login attempt.
